title: Workwear
sub: Blazers, coats, tailored trousers, dresses and cashmere from four brands, 40-79% off.

brands.say: Hero: Theodora eyelet shirt dress in black, was $529, now $111, 79% off, all 6 sizes in stock. Priscilla double-breasted blazer was $579, now $241, all 12 sizes. Bronny pleated trouser was $329, now $81.
brands.why_not: Dress and trouser are tagged final sale; the blazer is return for store credit only. The Theodora is sleeveless eyelet, more of a warm-weather piece.

items.name: Theodora Eyelet Dress
items.note: Biggest saving in the catalog ($418), full size run, clean full-length on-model shot

items.name: Priscilla Blazer
items.note: Classic beige double-breasted suit blazer, 12/12 sizes, saves $338

items.name: Bronny Pleated Trouser
items.note: Grey high-waist pleated wide-leg, 75% off, 11/12 sizes; img1 shows the full trouser

brands.say: UK store, prices in pounds. Hero: Wool Mix Tweed Blazer in brown, was 255 pounds, now 127.50, half off, all 8 sizes in stock. Oversized grey coat was 255, now 178.50. Framed neckline maxi dress was 175, now 70.
brands.why_not: UK store: was/now are GBP, not USD; US buyers should check shipping and duties. Return terms not shown in the catalog.

items.name: Wool Tweed Blazer
items.note: Sculpted hourglass tweed blazer, 8/8 sizes, strongest photo of the brand

items.name: Oversized Grey Coat
items.note: Long double-breasted grey wool-look coat, 5/5 sizes, only 30% off but a real staple

items.name: Framed Neck Maxi Dress
items.note: Black long-sleeve square-neck column dress for dinner, 60% off, 5/8 sizes

brands.say: Hero: Crosstown Trench in khaki, was $399, now $239, 4 of 6 sizes in stock. Hannah oversized blazer was $298, now $119, 60% off, 11 of 12 sizes. Morrison pleated pants in camel were $168, now $67.
brands.why_not: Items are tagged no-returns / exchange only (trench and pants also final sale). Homepage could not be read, so no sale wording was confirmed there.

items.name: Crosstown Trench
items.note: Classic belted khaki trench; img1 is a clean close on-model shot. 40% off, saves $160

items.name: Hannah Blazer
items.note: Oversized black double-breasted blazer shown as a suit, 60% off, 11/12 sizes

items.name: Morrison Pleated Pants
items.note: Camel pleated wide-leg trouser, 60% off, 7/7 sizes

brands.say: Hero: Barbra cashmere turtleneck in camel, was $495, now $297, all 5 sizes in stock. Irvin long blazer in grey was $750, now $450. Elias double pleat trouser in black was $395, now $237, all 8 sizes.
brands.why_not: All three are 40% off, not the 60% tier (the 60% items are mostly summer linen and occasion pieces). Homepage headline is 25% off; still expensive after discount.

items.name: Cashmere Turtleneck
items.note: Camel cashmere with matching trousers, the most polished office look; 5/5 sizes

items.name: Irvin Maxi Blazer
items.note: Floor-length grey tailored blazer coat, biggest saving ($300), 5/5 sizes
